text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Gold 
City...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold City's gaze was fixed on a crane game 
filled with plushies designed after 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Only girls everyone has high hopes for get 
to be modeled into Paka Petits, you know.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So... well, um. Maybe there's none, 
though.

Maybe they'll even have a Paka Petit of 
City!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
“Want to take a quick peek anyway? They 
actually look pretty well-made for 
plushies.”

text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
